name: Linux Bookworm → Trixie (OpenSSL 3.0 → 3.5 LTS), base image 0.10.0
base_branch: upgrade/phase-13-ruby-3-4 (PR #235, head 845d5e5, itself a draft against main at 10e5c5f). Stacked PR: the diff against #235 is Phase 14 only. If #235 merges first, rebase onto main and retarget the PR, as Phases 12 and 13 had to

changes.docker_base_image: ruby:3.4.12-slim-bookworm → ruby:3.4.12-slim-trixie in Dockerfile.base, Dockerfile.development, Dockerfile.production (one FROM line each; nothing else in the Dockerfiles changed). The tag exists for linux/amd64 and linux/arm64/v8 (plus arm/v5, arm/v7, 386, ppc64le, s390x) — `docker buildx imagetools inspect ruby:3.4.12-slim-trixie`, index digest sha256:dd852d6d…, built 2026-10-23 from debian:trixie-slim snapshot 20261020T213255Z
changes.debian: 12 (Bookworm) → 13 (Trixie); `cat /etc/debian_version` in the built dev image: 13.7. Security support to 2028-08-09, LTS to 2030-06-30
changes.openssl: 3.0.x → 3.5.7 LTS (`openssl version`: OpenSSL 3.5.7 9 Jun 2026; Debian package openssl / libssl3t64 3.5.7-1~deb13u3; Ruby's openssl ext 3.3.3 reports OpenSSL::OPENSSL_LIBRARY_VERSION 'OpenSSL 3.5.7 9 Jun 2026'). 3.5 is supported upstream to 2030-04-08
changes.toolchain: gcc 12 → 14.2.0 (Debian 14.2.0-19, via build-essential 12.12); apt 2.6 → 3.0.3; the image's sources are deb822 (/etc/apt/sources.list.d/debian.sources), no apt-key anywhere in the Dockerfiles
changes.libpq: Bookworm libpq-dev 15 → Trixie libpq-dev / libpq5 17.11-0+deb13u1 (pg_config --version: PostgreSQL 17.11). Not what the app links against: pg 1.7.0 installs as the precompiled aarch64-linux / x86_64-linux gem and `PG.library_version` still reports 180006 (bundled libpq 18.6) inside the Trixie image. libpq-dev stays as the source-build fallback
changes.apt_packages: build-essential 12.12, patch 2.8-2, zlib1g-dev 1:1.3.dfsg+really1.3.1-1+b1, liblzma-dev 5.8.1-1+deb13u2, libpq-dev 17.11-0+deb13u1, curl 8.14.1-2+deb13u7 — all six names unchanged on Trixie (`apt-cache policy` in a plain ruby:3.4.12-slim-trixie container). ruby-dev was already dropped in Phase 13; libyaml-dev still not needed (no psych gem in the bundle)
changes.nodesource: setup_26.x unchanged; its single `nodistro` suite installed nodejs 26.12.1-1nodesource1 on Trixie (arm64 and amd64), the same package Phase 13's Bookworm build got. `node -v` in the dev image: v26.12.1
changes.base_image_version: 0.9.0 → 0.10.0 in Dockerfile.ci (FROM), scripts/docker_build.rb (build_base_image tag) and scripts/docker_hub.rb (BASE_VERSION)
changes.gemfile_lock: UNCHANGED (Gemfile and Gemfile.lock byte-identical to Phase 13; `bundle install` on Trixie resolved the existing lock without re-resolving — 44 Gemfile dependencies, 182 gems on both arches)

commits.b1b84b3: Phase 14: Debian Bookworm → Trixie (ruby:3.4.12-slim-trixie), base image 0.10.0 (three FROM lines, Dockerfile.ci, docker_build.rb, docker_hub.rb)
commits.e9897ff: version_dates: linux.json → Debian 13 Trixie / OpenSSL 3.5 LTS; ruby.json and node.json source lines
commits.tracking: this file; latest_versions.json was regenerated with fetch_latest_versions.py first and came back identical (already refreshed on 2026-10-25)

native_gem_probe.method: the real builds, with output captured: `docker compose build --no-cache --progress=plain dev` (Dockerfile.development on arm64), `./go build base` (arm64) and `./go build base --multi-platform` (linux/amd64 + linux/arm64 under buildx). Then, inside the built dev image, every /usr/local/bundle/extensions/aarch64-linux/3.4.0/*/gem_make.out was grepped for `warning:` / `error:` and the GCC warning flags tallied. The brief's `gem install --platform ruby` per-gem form was not needed: bundler compiled every non-precompiled extension and none failed, so the parallel installer never aborted early (the failure mode PR #229 hit with byebug 10)
precompiled_not_compiled: nokogiri 1.19.4 (aarch64-linux-gnu / x86_64-linux-gnu via the Dockerfile `gem install nokogiri -v 1.19.4` pre-install; Nokogiri::VERSION_INFO libxml 2.13.9 precompiled=true)
native_gem_probe.errors: none; zero `error:` lines in any gem_make.out and no -Wincompatible-pointer-types anywhere (the GCC 14 promotion that broke byebug 10 in PR #229 — byebug 13 from Phase 13 is clean)

warnings.ffi 1.15.5: 388, all -Wdeprecated-declarations: `rb_data_object_get_warning is deprecated: by TypedData` (Ruby 3.4 C-API deprecation, not a GCC 14 change) plus four libffi `ffi_java_raw_*` deprecations
warnings.nio4r 2.7.5: 79: 67 -Wundef and a few -Wcomment / -Wparentheses / -Wdangling-else, all from the vendored libev
warnings.note: a Bookworm/GCC 12 baseline of the same counts was not captured, so these are 'present on Trixie', not 'new on Trixie'; none is an error and none is -Wincompatible-pointer-types. ffi 1.15.5 is the oldest extension left in the lock (2021); ffi 1.17.x would silence the TypedData deprecations if it ever moves

verification.go_start_health: `./go start` could not bind host port 3001 (held by the main checkout's automation-calculator-dev-1, a sibling session), so the same image was run detached with `docker compose … run -d -p 3011:3000 dev bash -c 'rails db:create db:migrate && rails s -b 0.0.0.0'` against this worktree's db container (docker-compose.local.yml override). `GET http://localhost:3011/health` → HTTP 200 `{"current_time_in_unix":…,"short_commit_hash":"4ba60c3","database":"ok"}`; Puma 8.0.2 on ruby 3.4.12, environment test. Then `docker stop` and `./go stop` (db container and network removed)
verification.dev_user_ownership: inside the running container `id` → uid=501(stevenuray) gid=1000 groups=1000,50(staff); a file and a directory created under /usr/src/app/tmp from inside appeared on the host as uid 501 (stevenuray:staff, gid shown as 20 on macOS). The `useradd --uid` dev-user pattern behaves the same on Trixie; probe files removed
verification.openssl_tls: inside the dev image, TLS to both OAuth providers under OpenSSL 3.5.7: accounts.google.com TLSv1.3 TLS_AES_256_GCM_SHA384 verify=0 (X509_V_OK), api.github.com TLSv1.3 TLS_AES_128_GCM_SHA256 verify=0; `URI.open` of https://accounts.google.com/.well-known/openid-configuration (1399 bytes) and https://api.github.com (2262 bytes) both read; printed ok. The sandbox had network, so this was really exercised

departures_from_plan.none_in_scope: the plan's Phase 14 is one FROM change per Dockerfile plus the base version bump, and that is the whole diff. ruby-dev was already gone (Phase 13), no apt package renamed, NodeSource needed no channel change
departures_from_plan.probe_form: the per-gem `gem install` probe was replaced by the real image builds plus a gem_make.out sweep, which gives the same per-gem compile verdict (and the warning flags) without a second toolchain install; the plan's risk — a 2018-era extension failing under GCC 14 — is answered: none of the 15 compiled extensions is older than ffi 1.15.5 (2021) and all compiled on both arches
departures_from_plan.libpq_wording: the plan's 'pg 1.7 links against Trixie's libpq 17 at build time' is not what happens (PR #229 already noted this): the precompiled pg gem ships libpq 18.6; the apt libpq-dev 17.11 is only there for a source build. Recorded in changes.libpq and linux.json

held_back.ffi_1_17: ffi 1.15.5 compiles but is the source of 388 TypedData deprecation warnings under Ruby 3.4's headers; bumping it is a Gemfile.lock change and this phase deliberately has none — a candidate for Phase 15/16's bundle update

notes.ci_red_until_base_pushed: Dockerfile.ci pulls automationcalculationsci/automation-calculator-base:0.10.0, which does not exist on Docker Hub until someone with Docker Hub login runs `docker login && ./go push base --multi-platform` from this branch (builds Dockerfile.base for linux/amd64,linux/arm64 and pushes :0.10.0), then `git commit --allow-empty -m 'Re-trigger CI now that base 0.10.0 is on Docker Hub' && git push`. Order: 0.9.0 from #235 first (so #235's CI can go green and merge), then 0.10.0 from this branch. This PR pushes no image
